items: NICE TRANSPARENT DESIGN - Unique transparent design makes the Wall Hooks almost invisible which is quite suitable for nice home decoration and outdoor decoration. Good adhesive wall hooks are never enough.

DURABLE RUST-RESISTANT BUILD - The clear adhesive hook made of high-quality stainless steel and PVC, rust-resistant and colorfast, the adhesive part is bigger than other small and thin wall hooks, ensuring with long life and rustproof.

EASY USE & QUICK INSTALLATION - No drilling, no screws, no nails and no glue, the utility wall hooks only Just tear off the protective layer on the back and paste it in the desired position, then put the hooks on smooth surface like tile, glass, metal, wooden door, stainless steel. 180 Degree rotating help you save the space.

UTILITY HOOKS - The adhesive wall hooks Widely used on a variety of smooth surfaces. This wall hooks heavy duty can be used variously: ceiling hooks, coat hooks, key hooks, plant hook, bath towel hook, picture hooks, towel hooks. Ideal for Christmas Lights and Christmas wreath also.

WHAT YOU GET - Value sticky adhesive hooks set includes 24 Pack adhesive wall hooks (33lb max loading) to meet your various needs, an utility and practical hooks for home, kitchen, bathroom, living room, entrance, office, factory and more places.These transparent hooks are very modern and stylish, These wall hooks perfect match with most home decoration.
